data.name: Lavanyadevi
data.long_meaning: Lavanyadevi is a goddess venerated in Hinduism and Buddhism. In Hinduism, she is identified with the goddess of love and beauty, Parvati. In Buddhism, she represents the Buddhist goddess of compassion, Guanyin. Her name means 'Goddess of beauty' or 'Goddess of grace'.

She is also believed to be a protector of women, and a source of strength and courage during difficult times. Overall, Lavanyadevi embodies both the physical and spiritual aspects of beauty, and is revered as a reminder of the divine feminine.
